-- SITTING: pre-launch train logistics SOAK (2026-10-03), slots 1-3; Scratch and 4-12 unbound.
-- GENERATED by tools/trains/soak/compose.py in the Opt-In repo from soak_slots.lua.txt;
-- edit that source and regenerate. Read-only stream: no fixture action, watch or
-- trigger runs at load. Shipping Code/ is untouched.
-- Pre-launch train logistics SOAK: slots 1-3 (body; compose.py adds the header and probe sweep).
-- Reads only. Nothing is written to a game object or a save. The one runtime switch it flips is
-- SMROptInPack.TrainTrace (never saved, 00_Core.lua), set while the soak is on and restored after.
--
-- Shipping code read for every field below (Opt-In repo Code/, HEAD at compose time):
--   StationRows_40_TrainDistribution.lua  D.Get/RowsOn/HubFor/Parent, D.ExportPairingStats, D.error,
--                                          D.Apply's per-mode desired amounts (export/import/balanced)
--   StationRows_10_TrainFloor.lua         Floor.stats.last_error
--   TrainHub_20_TrainHub.lua              hub upgrades (colony SMROptIn_hub_upgrades mirrored to every
--                                          hub), sync_hub_storage base 1000000/2000000, GetMaxDrones,
--                                          SMROptIn_track_work jobs + Floor.HubRepairTune.FlightGrace
--   TrainHub_70_TrainBay.lua              SMROptInTrainBay.stats.refused (the hub refuses add-train)
--   ElevatorDepot_10_ElevatorDepot.lua    PairOf, CABIN record {phase, ends, legs, cargo, started},
--                                          CabinCapacity, ROWS mirror, HalfWord -> policy, 250/500 cap
-- Vanilla (archived 1.1.1.406343 Src/Lua): Station.lua:964-995 SetDesiredAmount's three policies;
-- Train.lua:56-73 a train Idle re-checks every hour; MultiResourceDepot.lua:217-223 capacity change.
--
-- Cadence. A real-time poll (CFG.poll_ms) reads GameTime and does cheap checks every poll. Work runs
-- once per GAME HOUR boundary (several hours at once at Ultra are folded into one tick):
--   every tick         SOAK_TOTALS (one line), hourly invariant checks, change-only events
--   every 3 game hours SOAK_HUB per hub and SOAK_DEPOT per pair
--   every 12 game hours SOAK_STATION per station and SOAK_TRAIN per train, queued, at most
--                      CFG.lines_per_tick queued lines per tick (the rest follow next tick)
--   flags              SOAK_FLAG once per condition (then SOAK_CLEAR when it ends), capped per hour
-- Why a real-time thread and not an armed trigger: SMRTK disarms every armed action on SaveGameStart
-- and SavegameSaved (70_SMRTK_Core.lua), so an armed soak dies at the first autosave. A real-time
-- thread is not persisted (CommonLua/Core/persist.lua: only flagged real-time threads persist) and
-- holds no game-object field, so the soak continues through saves. It pauses its reads while
-- SavingGame is set (the rows restore vanilla baselines during a save) and logs each save. A load,
-- a new game or quitting stops it with a visible SOAK_STOP reason=... line.
-- Integer arithmetic only (EF-116): no bare division; MulDivRound and floor division.

local T = SMRTK
T.PreloadProbeSweep {
	command = "grep -rln \"TEMP" .. "ORARY\" Code/ ../SMR-BugFixPack-TestKit/Code/",
	output = "",
	pack_head = "214f0adec14862ab866a60e5bf80b6deff476cf4",
	testkit_head = "783a24dd08c793585fe45fba712785a8a50a1b89",
	checked_at = "2026-10-03T17:58:55.850078+00:00",
	brief = "pre-launch train soak (2026-10-03): read-only stream, no probes needed",
	exit = 1, hits = {}, needed = {},
}

local CFG = {
	poll_ms = 250,             -- real ms between polls
	summary_every_h = 3,       -- SOAK_HUB / SOAK_DEPOT
	dump_every_h = 12,         -- SOAK_STATION / SOAK_TRAIN (queued)
	lines_per_tick = 40,       -- hard cap on queued dump lines per hour tick
	flags_per_hour = 30,       -- new SOAK_FLAG lines per game hour; beyond that, counted as suppressed
	stuck_h = 3,               -- non-Idle train, same command + station + spot, for this many game hours
	idle_cargo_h = 12,         -- Idle train still carrying cargo for this many game hours
	cabin_overdue_min = 30,    -- cabin still travelling this many game minutes after its arrival time
	cabin_stall_h = 3,         -- cabin at rest, both halves working, no leg for this many game hours
	cabin_held_h = 2,          -- cabin at rest because a half is not working, this many game hours
	confirm_ms = 20000,        -- a desired-amount / mirror mismatch must still hold this much game time later
	job_overdue_h = 1,         -- track job past its fallback completion by this many game hours
	run_default_h = 12,        -- slot 3 with no number in the note box
	run_max_h = 240,
}

local UPGRADES = {
	{ "CN", "SMROptInTrainHub6_CapacityNetwork" }, { "TC", "SMROptInTrainHub6_TrainCargo" },
	{ "PW", "SMROptInTrainHub6_Power" }, { "SH", "SMROptInTrainHub6_StorageHub" },
}
local MODULES = { "StationRows", "TrainHub", "ElevatorDepot" }

local S = { state = false }   -- runtime only

-- ---- small readers ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function pack_api()
	local P = rawget(_G, "SMROptInPack")
	if type(P) ~= "table" or type(P.IsActive) ~= "function" then return nil end
	return P
end
local function dist_api()
	local D = rawget(_G, "SMROptInTrainDistribution")
	return type(D) == "table" and D.active and D or nil
end
local function depot_api()
	local D = rawget(_G, "SMRElevatorDepot")
	return type(D) == "table" and type(D.PairOf) == "function" and D or nil
end
local function now() return GameTime() end
local function hour_ms() return const.HourDuration end
local function id(o)
	if not IsValid(o) then return "none" end
	return tostring(o.class) .. "(" .. tostring(o.handle) .. ")"
end
local function handle(o) return IsValid(o) and tostring(o.handle) or "none" end
-- resource amount in tenths, "12.3"
local function u(n)
	if type(n) ~= "number" then return tostring(n) end
	local t = MulDivRound(n, 10, const.ResourceScale)
	local sign = ""
	if t < 0 then sign, t = "-", -t end
	return sign .. tostring(t // 10) .. "." .. tostring(t % 10)
end
-- game ms as hours in tenths, "1.5"
local function hours(ms)
	local t = MulDivRound(ms, 10, hour_ms())
	return tostring(t // 10) .. "." .. tostring(t % 10)
end
local function env(o)
	if not IsValid(o) or type(o.GetMap) ~= "function" or type(rawget(_G, "GetEnvironment")) ~= "function" then return "?" end
	local name = GetEnvironment(o:GetMap())
	return (name and name ~= "") and tostring(name) or "?"
end
local function is_hub(o) return IsValid(o) and IsKindOf(o, "SMROptInTrainHubBase") end
local function is_depot(o)
	local D = depot_api()
	return D and type(D.IsDepot) == "function" and D.IsDepot(o) or false
end
local function req(o, kind, res)
	local t = o[kind]
	return type(t) == "table" and t[res] or nil
end
local function stock(o, res)
	local s = req(o, "supply", res)
	return s and s:GetActualAmount() or 0
end
local function list_text(t, order)
	local parts = {}
	for _, k in ipairs(order) do
		local v = t[k]
		if v ~= nil and v ~= 0 then parts[#parts + 1] = k .. ":" .. (type(v) == "number" and u(v) or tostring(v)) end
	end
	return #parts > 0 and table.concat(parts, ",") or "none"
end
local function sorted_keys(t)
	local keys = {}
	for k in pairs(t) do keys[#keys + 1] = k end
	table.sort(keys)
	return keys
end
local function count_text(t)
	local parts = {}
	for _, k in ipairs(sorted_keys(t)) do parts[#parts + 1] = k .. ":" .. tostring(t[k]) end
	return #parts > 0 and table.concat(parts, ",") or "none"
end
local function cargo_of(train)
	local total, t = 0, {}
	for res, n in pairs(train.stockpiled_amount or empty_table) do
		if n ~= 0 then t[res] = n; total = total + n end
	end
	return t, total
end

local function log(verb, fields, screen)
	return T.Log(verb, fields, screen == true)
end

-- ---- the colony, by class, every map -------------------------------------------------------------
local function collect()
	local c = { hubs = {}, stations = {}, depots = {}, trains = {} }
	local seen = {}
	for _, city in ipairs(rawget(_G, "Cities") or empty_table) do
		local labels = city.labels or empty_table
		for _, o in ipairs(labels.Station or empty_table) do
			if IsValid(o) and not seen[o] then
				seen[o] = true
				if is_hub(o) then c.hubs[#c.hubs + 1] = o
				elseif is_depot(o) then c.depots[#c.depots + 1] = o
				elseif IsKindOf(o, "Station") then c.stations[#c.stations + 1] = o end
			end
		end
		for _, o in ipairs(labels.Train or empty_table) do
			if IsValid(o) and not seen[o] then seen[o] = true; c.trains[#c.trains + 1] = o end
		end
	end
	local by_handle = function(a, b) return a.handle < b.handle end
	table.sort(c.hubs, by_handle); table.sort(c.stations, by_handle)
	table.sort(c.depots, by_handle); table.sort(c.trains, by_handle)
	return c
end

-- ---- station rows -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- The row the code applies (D.Apply): a STORED row on a station whose rows are on. Untouched rows
-- are Balanced at the vanilla dial for trains only; their drone amounts stay vanilla's.
local function stored_row(D, st, res)
	if not (D and type(D.RowsOn) == "function" and type(D.Get) == "function") then return nil end
	if not D.RowsOn(st) then return nil end
	local entry = D.Get(st, res)
	return type(entry) == "table" and entry.mode and entry or nil
end
local function row_mode(D, st, res)
	if not st:IsResourceEnabled(res) then return "off" end
	if not (D and type(D.RowsOn) == "function" and D.RowsOn(st)) then return "vanilla" end
	local entry = stored_row(D, st, res)
	if entry then return tostring(entry.mode) .. tostring(entry.percent or entry.amount) end
	return "dial" .. u(st.desired_amount or 0)
end
-- Expected drone desired amounts for a stored row: Station.lua:964-995 with D.Apply's capacity
-- (the row resource's own GetMaxStorage) and slider amount MulDivRound(cap, percent, 100).
local function station_expect(D, st, res)
	local s, d = req(st, "supply", res), req(st, "demand", res)
	if not s or not d or not st:IsResourceEnabled(res) then return nil end
	local entry = stored_row(D, st, res)
	if not entry then return nil end
	local cap = st:GetMaxStorage(res)
	local n = entry.amount
	if n == nil then
		if math.type(entry.percent) ~= "integer" then return nil end
		n = MulDivRound(cap, entry.percent, 100)
	end
	if math.type(n) ~= "integer" then return nil end
	n = Clamp(n, 0, cap)
	local es, ed
	if entry.mode == "export" then es, ed = cap, 0
	elseif entry.mode == "import" then es, ed = 0, cap
	else es, ed = n, cap - n end
	local as, ad = s:GetDesiredAmount(), d:GetDesiredAmount()
	if as == es and ad == ed then return nil end
	return { mode = entry.mode, percent = entry.percent, cap = u(cap),
		supply_desired = u(as), expected_supply = u(es), demand_desired = u(ad), expected_demand = u(ed) }
end
local function station_signature(D, st)
	local parts = { "hub=" .. handle(D and D.HubFor and D.HubFor(st)) }
	for _, res in ipairs(st.storable_resources or empty_table) do
		if req(st, "supply", res) then parts[#parts + 1] = res .. ":" .. row_mode(D, st, res) end
	end
	return table.concat(parts, ",")
end

-- ---- the Elevator Depot -------------------------------------------------------------------------
local POLICY = { gather = "send", hand_out = "accept", plain = "default" }
local function depot_pair(c)
	local D = depot_api()
	if not D then return nil end
	local surface, underground = D.PairOf()
	local live = 0
	for _, o in ipairs(c.depots) do if not o.destroyed then live = live + 1 end end
	local rec = surface and rawget(surface, D.CABIN)
	return { D = D, surface = surface, underground = underground, live = live,
		extras = surface and (live - 2) or 0, rec = type(rec) == "table" and rec or nil }
end
local function aboard(rec)
	local n = 0
	for _, a in pairs(rec and rec.cargo or empty_table) do n = n + a end
	return n
end
-- Vanilla's formula for the half's live policy, and the policy the half's row says it should hold.
local function depot_expect(D, o, res)
	local s, d = req(o, "supply", res), req(o, "demand", res)
	if not s or not d or type(D.HalfWord) ~= "function" then return nil end
	local word = D.HalfWord(o, res)
	local enabled = o:IsResourceEnabled(res) and true or false
	if word == "disabled" then
		if enabled then return { part = "accept", word = word, enabled = enabled } end
		return nil
	end
	if not enabled then return { part = "accept", word = word, enabled = enabled } end
	local want = POLICY[word] or "default"
	local policy = (o.transport_policy and o.transport_policy[res]) or "default"
	if policy ~= want then return { part = "policy", word = word, policy = policy, expected_policy = want } end
	local max, dial = o:GetMaxStorageForAnyOneResource(), o.desired_amount
	if math.type(dial) ~= "integer" or math.type(max) ~= "integer" then return nil end
	local amount = Clamp(dial, 0, max)
	local es, ed
	if policy == "accept" then es, ed = 0, max
	elseif policy == "send" then es, ed = max, 0
	else es, ed = amount, max - amount end
	local as, ad = s:GetDesiredAmount(), d:GetDesiredAmount()
	if as == es and ad == ed then return nil end
	return { part = "amounts", word = word, policy = policy, max = u(max), dial = u(dial),
		supply_desired = u(as), expected_supply = u(es), demand_desired = u(ad), expected_demand = u(ed) }
end
local function rows_text(D, o)
	local parts = {}
	for _, res in ipairs(o.storable_resources or empty_table) do
		if req(o, "supply", res) and type(D.State) == "function" then
			local word = type(D.WordOf) == "function" and D.WordOf(D.State(o, res)) or D.State(o, res)
			parts[#parts + 1] = res .. ":" .. tostring(word)
		end
	end
	return #parts > 0 and table.concat(parts, ",") or "none"
end
local function stock_text(o, with_zero)
	local t = {}
	for _, res in ipairs(o.storable_resources or empty_table) do
		local n = stock(o, res)
		if n ~= 0 or with_zero then t[res] = n end
	end
	return list_text(t, o.storable_resources or empty_table)
end

-- ---- lines ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function hub_fields(h, owned)
	local colony = h.city and h.city.colony
	local entries = colony and rawget(colony, "SMROptIn_hub_upgrades") or empty_table
	local upg = {}
	for _, pair in ipairs(UPGRADES) do
		local bought = type(h.HasUpgrade) == "function" and h:HasUpgrade(pair[2])
		local on = bought and type(h.IsUpgradeOn) == "function" and h:IsUpgradeOn(pair[2])
		upg[#upg + 1] = pair[1] .. ":" .. (not bought and "-" or on and "on" or "off")
	end
	local work = rawget(h, "SMROptIn_track_work")
	local jobs, dispatched, waiting = 0, 0, 0
	for _, job in ipairs(type(work) == "table" and work.jobs or empty_table) do
		jobs = jobs + 1
		if job.deadline then dispatched = dispatched + 1 end
		if job.waiting then waiting = waiting + 1 end
	end
	local over = {}
	for _, res in ipairs(h.storable_resources or empty_table) do
		if stock(h, res) > h:GetMaxStorage(res) then over[#over + 1] = res end
	end
	local first = (h.storable_resources or empty_table)[1]
	return { hub = id(h), map = env(h), working = tostring(h.working), ui_working = tostring(h.ui_working),
		destroyed = tostring(h.destroyed or false), prod = u(h.electricity_production or 0),
		cons = u(h.electricity_consumption or 0), cap = first and u(h:GetMaxStorage(first)) or "none",
		stock = stock_text(h), over = #over > 0 and table.concat(over, ",") or "none",
		upgrades = table.concat(upg, ","), drones = #(h.drones or empty_table),
		max_drones = type(h.GetMaxDrones) == "function" and h:GetMaxDrones() or -1,
		jobs = jobs, dispatched = dispatched, waiting = waiting, stations = owned or 0,
		colony_upgrades = count_text((function()
			local t = {}
			for k, e in pairs(entries) do t[tostring(k):gsub("^SMROptInTrainHub6_", "")] = e.on and "on" or "off" end
			return t
		end)()) }
end
local function depot_fields(p)
	local D, s, g, rec = p.D, p.surface, p.underground, p.rec
	local f = { paired = tostring(s ~= nil), live_halves = p.live, extras = p.extras }
	if s then
		local first = (s.storable_resources or empty_table)[1]
		f.surface, f.underground = id(s), id(g)
		f.phase = rec and tostring(rec.phase) or "none"
		f.legs = rec and (rec.legs or 0) or 0
		f.ends_in_min = rec and rec.ends and MulDivRound(Max(rec.ends - now(), 0), 1, const.MinuteDuration) or 0
		f.aboard = list_text(rec and rec.cargo or empty_table, sorted_keys(rec and rec.cargo or empty_table))
		f.cabin_cap = type(D.CabinCapacity) == "function" and D.CabinCapacity(s) or -1
		f.s_working, f.u_working = tostring(s.working), tostring(g.working)
		f.s_drones = rawget(s, D.DRONES) and "on" or "off"
		f.u_drones = rawget(g, D.DRONES) and "on" or "off"
		f.s_cap = first and u(s:GetMaxStorage(first)) or "none"
		f.u_cap = first and u(g:GetMaxStorage(first)) or "none"
		f.s_stock, f.u_stock = stock_text(s), stock_text(g)
	end
	return f
end
local function station_fields(D, st, why)
	local tokens = {}
	for _, res in ipairs(st.storable_resources or empty_table) do
		local s, d = req(st, "supply", res), req(st, "demand", res)
		if s and d then
			local mode = row_mode(D, st, res)
			local n = s:GetActualAmount()
			if mode ~= "off" or n ~= 0 then
				tokens[#tokens + 1] = res .. ":" .. mode .. ":" .. u(n) .. ":" .. u(s:GetDesiredAmount())
					.. ":" .. u(d:GetDesiredAmount())
			end
		end
	end
	local first = (st.storable_resources or empty_table)[1]
	return { station = id(st), map = env(st), why = why, working = tostring(st.working),
		hub = handle(D and D.HubFor and D.HubFor(st)), parent = handle(D and D.Parent and D.Parent(st)),
		rows_on = tostring(D and D.RowsOn and D.RowsOn(st) or false),
		cap = first and u(st:GetMaxStorage(first)) or "none",
		res = #tokens > 0 and table.concat(tokens, ",") or "none" }
end
local function train_sig(train)
	local pos = type(train.GetPos) == "function" and train:GetPos()
	local spot = pos and (tostring(pos:x() // 1000) .. "." .. tostring(pos:y() // 1000)) or "?"
	return tostring(train.command) .. "|" .. handle(train.current_station) .. "|" .. spot
end
local function train_fields(train, why, since)
	local cargo, total = cargo_of(train)
	return { train = id(train), map = env(train), why = why, station = id(train.current_station),
		track = handle(train.track), command = tostring(train.command), at_station = tostring(train.at_station),
		cargo = list_text(cargo, sorted_keys(cargo)), total = u(total), cap = u(train.max_shared_storage or 0),
		same_h = since and hours(now() - since) or "?" }
end

-- ---- totals ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function totals(c, p)
	local all, parts = {}, { hubs = {}, stations = {}, trains = {}, cabin = {} }
	local function add(part, res, n)
		if n == 0 then return end
		all[res] = (all[res] or 0) + n
		parts[part][res] = (parts[part][res] or 0) + n
	end
	for _, h in ipairs(c.hubs) do
		for _, res in ipairs(h.storable_resources or empty_table) do add("hubs", res, stock(h, res)) end
	end
	for _, list in ipairs({ c.stations, c.depots }) do
		for _, st in ipairs(list) do
			for _, res in ipairs(st.storable_resources or empty_table) do add("stations", res, stock(st, res)) end
		end
	end
	local by_cmd = {}
	for _, train in ipairs(c.trains) do
		local cmd = tostring(train.command)
		by_cmd[cmd] = (by_cmd[cmd] or 0) + 1
		for res, n in pairs(train.stockpiled_amount or empty_table) do add("trains", res, n) end
	end
	if p and p.rec then
		for res, n in pairs(p.rec.cargo or empty_table) do add("cabin", res, n) end
	end
	return all, parts, by_cmd
end

-- ---- flags -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- A condition flag prints once when it starts and SOAK_CLEAR when an hourly check no longer sees
-- it. An event flag (errors, refusals, a train in the hub) prints every time it happens.
local function emit_flag(state, kind, fields)
	state.flag_counts[kind] = (state.flag_counts[kind] or 0) + 1
	if state.flags_this_hour >= CFG.flags_per_hour then
		state.suppressed = state.suppressed + 1
		return false
	end
	state.flags_this_hour = state.flags_this_hour + 1
	fields.kind = kind
	fields.sol = UIColony and UIColony.day or -1
	log("SOAK_FLAG", fields, true)
	return true
end
local function condition(state, kind, key, fields)
	local k = kind .. "|" .. key
	local a = state.active[k]
	if a then a.seen = state.tick; return end
	local printed = emit_flag(state, kind, fields)
	state.active[k] = { kind = kind, key = key, since = now(), seen = state.tick, printed = printed }
end
local function event_flag(state, kind, fields) emit_flag(state, kind, fields) end
-- A mismatch must still hold CFG.confirm_ms later (vanilla rewrites, then the rows re-apply on the
-- next BuildingUpdate, every 5000 game ms, Station.lua:83).
local function confirm(state, kind, key, recheck)
	local k = kind .. "|" .. key
	if state.active[k] then state.active[k].seen = state.tick; return end
	if not state.pending[k] then
		state.pending[k] = { kind = kind, key = key, due = now() + CFG.confirm_ms, recheck = recheck }
	end
end
local function run_pending(state)
	local t = now()
	for k, p in pairs(state.pending) do
		if t >= p.due then
			state.pending[k] = nil
			local fields = p.recheck()
			if fields then condition(state, p.kind, p.key, fields) end
		end
	end
end
local function clear_stale(state)
	for k, a in pairs(state.active) do
		if a.seen < state.tick then
			state.active[k] = nil
			if a.printed then
				log("SOAK_CLEAR", { kind = a.kind, key = a.key, lasted_h = hours(now() - a.since) })
			end
		end
	end
end

-- ---- the hourly checks -------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function check_hubs(state, c, D)
	local colony_entries
	local seen_hubs = {}
	for _, h in ipairs(c.hubs) do
		local key = handle(h)
		local was = state.hub_working[h]
		local w = tostring(h.working) .. "/" .. tostring(h.ui_working) .. "/" .. tostring(h.destroyed or false)
		if was == nil then log("SOAK_EVENT", { what = "hub_added", hub = id(h), state = w })
		elseif was ~= w then log("SOAK_EVENT", { what = "hub_state", hub = id(h), before = was, after = w }) end
		state.hub_working[h] = w
		seen_hubs[h] = true
		if not h.destroyed then
			-- storage: the owner's ruling allows stock above a DROPPED capacity (spec 4.10); only a rise
			-- while above capacity is flagged
			for _, res in ipairs(h.storable_resources or empty_table) do
				local n, cap = stock(h, res), h:GetMaxStorage(res)
				local prev = state.prev_stock[h] and state.prev_stock[h][res]
				if n > cap and prev and n > prev then
					condition(state, "hub_over_capacity", key .. "|" .. res,
						{ hub = id(h), resource = res, stock = u(n), cap = u(cap), before = u(prev) })
				elseif n > cap and state.active["hub_over_capacity|" .. key .. "|" .. res] then
					state.active["hub_over_capacity|" .. key .. "|" .. res].seen = state.tick
				end
				state.prev_stock[h] = state.prev_stock[h] or {}
				state.prev_stock[h][res] = n
			end
			-- the fleet never exceeds MaxDrones (TrainHub_20 SpawnDrone)
			local n, max = #(h.drones or empty_table), type(h.GetMaxDrones) == "function" and h:GetMaxDrones() or nil
			if max and n > max then condition(state, "hub_drones_over_max", key, { hub = id(h), drones = n, max = max }) end
			-- one colony switch per upgrade, mirrored to every hub's panel fields (spec 4.10, 2026-09-29)
			local colony = h.city and h.city.colony
			colony_entries = colony and rawget(colony, "SMROptIn_hub_upgrades") or empty_table
			for _, pair in ipairs(UPGRADES) do
				local entry = colony_entries[pair[2]]
				local function recheck()
					local e = (colony and rawget(colony, "SMROptIn_hub_upgrades") or empty_table)[pair[2]]
					local mirror = h.upgrade_on_off_state and h.upgrade_on_off_state[pair[2]]
					if IsValid(h) and e and (mirror and true or false) ~= (e.on and true or false) then
						return { hub = id(h), upgrade = pair[1], colony_on = tostring(e.on), hub_mirror = tostring(mirror) }
					end
				end
				if entry and recheck() then confirm(state, "hub_upgrade_mirror", key .. "|" .. pair[1], recheck) end
			end
			-- Storage Hub sets the base: 1000000, or 2000000 while on (sync_hub_storage)
			local function base_check()
				local e = (colony and rawget(colony, "SMROptIn_hub_upgrades") or empty_table)["SMROptInTrainHub6_StorageHub"]
				local want = e and e.on and 2000000 or 1000000
				if IsValid(h) and not h.destroyed and h.base_max_storage_per_resource ~= want then
					return { hub = id(h), base = u(h.base_max_storage_per_resource or 0), expected = u(want) }
				end
			end
			if base_check() then confirm(state, "hub_storage_base", key, base_check) end
			-- a dispatched track job completes at its Wasp's work end, or at the fallback deadline plus
			-- FlightGrace; a job waiting for stock is the intended hold (spec 10, L5)
			local tune = rawget(_G, "SMROptInTrainFloor") and SMROptInTrainFloor.HubRepairTune
			local grace = tune and tune.FlightGrace or 100
			local work = rawget(h, "SMROptIn_track_work")
			for i, job in ipairs(type(work) == "table" and work.jobs or empty_table) do
				if job.deadline and not job.waiting then
					local cap = job.deadline + MulDivRound(job.deadline - (job.started or job.deadline), grace, 100)
					if now() > cap + CFG.job_overdue_h * hour_ms() then
						condition(state, "track_job_overdue", key .. "|" .. handle(job.site) .. "|" .. tostring(job.kind),
							{ hub = id(h), job = tostring(job.kind), site = id(job.site), overdue_h = hours(now() - cap),
							  drone = id(job.drone) })
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	for h in pairs(state.hub_working) do
		if not seen_hubs[h] then
			state.hub_working[h] = nil
			log("SOAK_EVENT", { what = "hub_removed", hub = id(h) })
		end
	end
end

local function check_stations(state, c, D)
	for _, st in ipairs(c.stations) do
		local key = handle(st)
		local sig = station_signature(D, st)
		local was = state.station_sig[st]
		if was == nil then
			state.queue_front[#state.queue_front + 1] = { "station", st, "new" }
		elseif was ~= sig then
			state.queue_front[#state.queue_front + 1] = { "station", st, "change" }
		end
		state.station_sig[st] = sig
		for _, res in ipairs(st.storable_resources or empty_table) do
			if station_expect(D, st, res) then
				confirm(state, "station_desired_mismatch", key .. "|" .. res, function()
					if not IsValid(st) then return nil end
					local Dn = dist_api()
					local f = station_expect(Dn, st, res)
					if f then f.station, f.resource, f.hub = id(st), res, handle(Dn.HubFor and Dn.HubFor(st)) end
					return f
				end)
			end
			local n, cap = stock(st, res), req(st, "supply", res) and st:GetMaxStorage(res) or nil
			local prev = state.prev_stock[st] and state.prev_stock[st][res]
			local akey = "station_over_capacity|" .. key .. "|" .. res
			if cap and n > cap and prev and n > prev then
				condition(state, "station_over_capacity", key .. "|" .. res,
					{ station = id(st), resource = res, stock = u(n), cap = u(cap), before = u(prev) })
			elseif cap and n > cap and state.active[akey] then
				state.active[akey].seen = state.tick
			end
			state.prev_stock[st] = state.prev_stock[st] or {}
			state.prev_stock[st][res] = n
		end
	end
end

local function check_depot(state, c, p)
	if not p then return end
	local D = p.D
	local sig = handle(p.surface) .. ":" .. handle(p.underground) .. ":" .. tostring(p.live)
	if state.pair_sig ~= nil and state.pair_sig ~= sig then
		log("SOAK_EVENT", { what = "depot_pair", before = state.pair_sig, after = sig })
	end
	state.pair_sig = sig
	-- one pair per colony; a further half stays an unpaired extra (trace "pair limit")
	if p.extras > 0 then condition(state, "depot_extra_half", "pair", { live_halves = p.live, extras = p.extras }) end
	if not p.surface and p.live > 0 then
		local halves = {}
		for _, o in ipairs(c.depots) do if not o.destroyed then halves[#halves + 1] = id(o) .. "@" .. env(o) end end
		condition(state, "depot_unpaired", "pair", { halves = table.concat(halves, ",") })
	end
	if not p.surface then return end
	local s, g, rec = p.surface, p.underground, p.rec
	local t = now()
	if rec then
		local legs = rec.legs or 0
		if state.cabin_legs ~= legs or state.cabin_phase ~= rec.phase then
			state.cabin_legs, state.cabin_phase, state.cabin_since = legs, rec.phase, t
		end
		local moving = rec.phase == "down" or rec.phase == "up"
		local both = s.working and g.working
		if moving and rec.ends and t > rec.ends + CFG.cabin_overdue_min * const.MinuteDuration then
			condition(state, "cabin_overdue", "cabin", { phase = tostring(rec.phase), legs = legs,
				late_min = MulDivRound(t - rec.ends, 1, const.MinuteDuration) })
		end
		if not moving and both and t - state.cabin_since >= CFG.cabin_stall_h * hour_ms() then
			condition(state, "cabin_stalled", "cabin", { phase = tostring(rec.phase), legs = legs,
				still_h = hours(t - state.cabin_since), started = tostring(rec.started or false) })
		end
		if not moving and not both and t - state.cabin_since >= CFG.cabin_held_h * hour_ms() then
			condition(state, "cabin_held", "cabin", { phase = tostring(rec.phase), s_working = tostring(s.working),
				u_working = tostring(g.working), still_h = hours(t - state.cabin_since) })
		end
		local cap = type(D.CabinCapacity) == "function" and MulDivRound(D.CabinCapacity(s), const.ResourceScale, 1)
		if cap and aboard(rec) > cap then
			condition(state, "cabin_over_capacity", "cabin", { aboard = u(aboard(rec)), cap = u(cap) })
		end
	end
	-- the underground half holds a read-only copy of the surface rows (OnPairChanged, SetRow)
	local function rows_check()
		local sr, gr = rawget(s, D.ROWS) or empty_table, rawget(g, D.ROWS) or empty_table
		local diff = {}
		for _, res in ipairs(s.storable_resources or empty_table) do
			local a, b = sr[res], gr[res]
			if (a or "to_underground") ~= (b or "to_underground") then diff[#diff + 1] = res end
		end
		if #diff > 0 and IsValid(s) and IsValid(g) then
			return { surface = id(s), underground = id(g), differ = table.concat(diff, ",") }
		end
	end
	if rows_check() then confirm(state, "depot_rows_mismatch", "rows", rows_check) end
	-- capacity: 250 per resource, 500 with Expanded Depot; Capacity Network excluded (spec 11)
	local expanded = (s.upgrades_built and s.upgrades_built[D.CAPACITY_UPGRADE])
		or (g.upgrades_built and g.upgrades_built[D.CAPACITY_UPGRADE])
	local want = expanded and 500000 or 250000
	for _, half in ipairs({ s, g }) do
		local hkey = handle(half)
		for _, res in ipairs(half.storable_resources or empty_table) do
			if req(half, "supply", res) then
				local cap, n = half:GetMaxStorage(res), stock(half, res)
				if cap ~= want then
					condition(state, "depot_capacity", hkey, { half = id(half), resource = res, cap = u(cap), expected = u(want) })
				end
				local prev = state.prev_stock[half] and state.prev_stock[half][res]
				local akey = "depot_over_capacity|" .. hkey .. "|" .. res
				if n > cap and prev and n > prev then
					condition(state, "depot_over_capacity", hkey .. "|" .. res,
						{ half = id(half), resource = res, stock = u(n), cap = u(cap), before = u(prev) })
				elseif n > cap and state.active[akey] then
					state.active[akey].seen = state.tick
				end
				state.prev_stock[half] = state.prev_stock[half] or {}
				state.prev_stock[half][res] = n
				if depot_expect(D, half, res) then
					confirm(state, "depot_desired_mismatch", hkey .. "|" .. res, function()
						local Dd = depot_api()
						if not Dd or not IsValid(half) then return nil end
						local f = depot_expect(Dd, half, res)
						if f then f.half, f.resource = id(half), res end
						return f
					end)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

local function check_trains(state, c)
	local t = now()
	for _, train in ipairs(c.trains) do
		local key = handle(train)
		local sig = train_sig(train)
		local rec = state.train_state[train]
		if not rec or rec.sig ~= sig then
			rec = { sig = sig, since = t }
			state.train_state[train] = rec
		end
		local cargo, total = cargo_of(train)
		local cmd = tostring(train.command)
		if cmd ~= "Idle" and t - rec.since >= CFG.stuck_h * hour_ms() then
			condition(state, "train_stuck", key, { train = id(train), command = cmd, station = id(train.current_station),
				track = handle(train.track), same_h = hours(t - rec.since), cargo = u(total) })
		end
		if cmd == "Idle" and total > 0 and t - rec.since >= CFG.idle_cargo_h * hour_ms() then
			condition(state, "train_idle_with_cargo", key, { train = id(train), station = id(train.current_station),
				cargo = list_text(cargo, sorted_keys(cargo)), same_h = hours(t - rec.since) })
		end
		local cap = train.max_shared_storage
		local prev = state.prev_cargo[train]
		if type(cap) == "number" and total > cap and prev and total > prev then
			condition(state, "train_over_capacity", key, { train = id(train), cargo = u(total), cap = u(cap), before = u(prev) })
		elseif type(cap) == "number" and total > cap and state.active["train_over_capacity|" .. key] then
			state.active["train_over_capacity|" .. key].seen = state.tick
		end
		state.prev_cargo[train] = total
	end
end

-- ---- every poll: cheap event checks --------------------------------------------------------------
local function code_errors()
	local D, F, B = rawget(_G, "SMROptInTrainDistribution"), rawget(_G, "SMROptInTrainFloor"), rawget(_G, "SMROptInTrainBay")
	local E = rawget(_G, "SMRElevatorDepot")
	return {
		distribution = type(D) == "table" and D.error or false,
		floor = type(F) == "table" and type(F.stats) == "table" and F.stats.last_error or false,
		bay = type(B) == "table" and B.error or false,
		depot = type(E) == "table" and E.error or false,
	}
end
local function each_train(fn)
	local seen = {}
	for _, city in ipairs(rawget(_G, "Cities") or empty_table) do
		for _, o in ipairs((city.labels or empty_table).Train or empty_table) do
			if IsValid(o) and not seen[o] then seen[o] = true; fn(o) end
		end
	end
	return seen
end
local function poll_events(state)
	-- new engine / Lua errors (SMRTK counts OnLuaError and OnThreadError; 70_SMRTK_Core.lua)
	if T.error_count ~= state.errors then
		event_flag(state, "lua_error", { new = T.error_count - state.errors, total = T.error_count - state.errors0 })
		state.errors = T.error_count
	end
	-- the hub refuses add-train (TrainBay); each refusal is someone or something asking for a train
	-- in the hub (spec 4.8 ruling 10)
	local B = rawget(_G, "SMROptInTrainBay")
	local refused = type(B) == "table" and type(B.stats) == "table" and B.stats.refused or 0
	if refused ~= state.bay_refused then
		event_flag(state, "bay_refused", { new = refused - state.bay_refused, total = refused })
		state.bay_refused = refused
	end
	for name, value in pairs(code_errors()) do
		if value and value ~= state.code_errors[name] then
			event_flag(state, "code_error", { part = name, message = tostring(value) })
		end
		state.code_errors[name] = value
	end
	-- trains: a new train is added at a station, never in the hub (spec 4.8 ruling 10)
	local live = each_train(function(train)
		if not state.known[train] then
			state.known[train] = true
			-- first seen at a hub after it already moved there is ordinary traffic; a spawn is
			-- at_spawn_track (set by TrackBase:AssignTrain, cleared at departure), checked below
			local st = train.current_station
			log("SOAK_EVENT", { what = "train_added", train = id(train), station = id(st), map = env(train),
				at_hub = tostring(is_hub(st)), spawn_track = tostring(train.at_spawn_track or false) })
		end
		if train.at_spawn_track and is_hub(train.current_station) and not state.spawn_flagged[train] then
			state.spawn_flagged[train] = true
			event_flag(state, "train_in_hub", { train = id(train), hub = id(train.current_station), how = "spawn_track_at_hub" })
		end
	end)
	for train in pairs(state.known) do
		if not live[train] then
			state.known[train] = nil
			log("SOAK_EVENT", { what = "train_removed", train = id(train) })
		end
	end
	-- module toggles and the trace switch
	local P = pack_api()
	if P then
		for _, m in ipairs(MODULES) do
			local on = P.IsActive(m) and true or false
			if state.modules[m] ~= on then
				log("SOAK_EVENT", { what = "module", module = m, active = tostring(on) })
				state.modules[m] = on
			end
		end
		if P.TrainTrace ~= true then
			log("SOAK_EVENT", { what = "trace_reset", trace = tostring(P.TrainTrace), action = "set_true" })
			P.TrainTrace = true
		end
	end
end

-- ---- the tick ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function emit_hubs_and_depot(c, D, p, why)
	local owned = {}
	if D and type(D.HubFor) == "function" then
		for _, st in ipairs(c.stations) do
			local h = D.HubFor(st)
			if h then owned[h] = (owned[h] or 0) + 1 end
		end
	end
	for _, h in ipairs(c.hubs) do
		local f = hub_fields(h, owned[h])
		f.why = why
		log("SOAK_HUB", f)
	end
	if p and p.live > 0 then
		local f = depot_fields(p)
		f.why = why
		log("SOAK_DEPOT", f)
	end
end
local function emit_totals(state, c, p, why, peek)
	local all, parts, by_cmd = totals(c, p)
	local order = sorted_keys(all)
	local D = dist_api()
	local pair = D and D.ExportPairingStats or empty_table
	local pairing = {}
	for _, k in ipairs({ "capped", "retried", "substituted", "refused" }) do
		local v = pair[k] or 0
		pairing[#pairing + 1] = k .. ":" .. tostring(v - (state.pairing[k] or v))
		if not peek then state.pairing[k] = v end
	end
	local active = {}
	for _, a in pairs(state.active) do active[a.kind] = (active[a.kind] or 0) + 1 end
	log("SOAK_TOTALS", { why = why, h = GameTime() // hour_ms(), sol = UIColony and UIColony.day or -1,
		all = list_text(all, order), hubs = list_text(parts.hubs, order), stations = list_text(parts.stations, order),
		trains = list_text(parts.trains, order), cabin = list_text(parts.cabin, order), by_command = count_text(by_cmd),
		n_hubs = #c.hubs, n_stations = #c.stations, n_depots = #c.depots, n_trains = #c.trains,
		errors = T.error_count - state.errors0, flags = state.flags_total_printed(), active = count_text(active),
		suppressed = state.suppressed, pairing = table.concat(pairing, ",") })
end

local function hourly(state)
	state.tick = state.tick + 1
	state.flags_this_hour = 0
	local c = collect()
	local D = dist_api()
	local p = depot_pair(c)
	check_hubs(state, c, D)
	check_stations(state, c, D)
	check_depot(state, c, p)
	check_trains(state, c)
	clear_stale(state)
	local h = GameTime() // hour_ms()
	emit_totals(state, c, p, "hour")
	local budget = CFG.lines_per_tick
	if h - state.last_summary >= CFG.summary_every_h then
		state.last_summary = h
		emit_hubs_and_depot(c, D, p, "periodic")
	end
	if h - state.last_dump >= CFG.dump_every_h then
		state.last_dump = h
		for _, st in ipairs(c.stations) do state.queue[#state.queue + 1] = { "station", st, "periodic" } end
		for _, train in ipairs(c.trains) do state.queue[#state.queue + 1] = { "train", train, "periodic" } end
	end
	-- change lines first, then the periodic queue, within one budget
	local front, rest = state.queue_front, state.queue
	state.queue_front = {}
	local merged = {}
	for _, e in ipairs(front) do merged[#merged + 1] = e end
	for _, e in ipairs(rest) do merged[#merged + 1] = e end
	local left = {}
	for _, e in ipairs(merged) do
		if budget > 0 then
			if IsValid(e[2]) then
				budget = budget - 1
				if e[1] == "station" then log("SOAK_STATION", station_fields(D, e[2], e[3]))
				else
					local r = state.train_state[e[2]]
					log("SOAK_TRAIN", train_fields(e[2], e[3], r and r.since))
				end
			end
		else
			left[#left + 1] = e
		end
	end
	state.queue = left
end

local function relabel()
	local on = S.state and true or false
	local d1, d3 = T.actions.slot_1, T.actions.slot_3
	if d1 then
		d1.label = on and "SOAK is ON - press to stop (trace on; hourly totals, flags, 3h hub/depot, 12h stations/trains)"
			or "SOAK OFF - press to start: trace on + live stream of hubs, depot, stations, trains and SOAK_FLAG problem lines"
	end
	if d3 then
		local r = S.state and S.state.run_until
		d3.label = r and ("Ultra run in progress until game hour " .. tostring(r // hour_ms()) .. " - press to cancel the run (soak stays on)")
			or "Run Ultra for N game hours, then pause + flush (N = number in the note box, default 12; starts the soak)"
	end
end

local function stop(reason, final)
	local state = S.state
	if not state then return nil end
	S.state = false
	state.cancelled = true
	local summary = { reason = reason, hours = state.start_hour and (GameTime() // hour_ms() - state.start_hour) or 0,
		flags = state.flags_total_printed(), suppressed = state.suppressed, errors = T.error_count - state.errors0,
		kinds = count_text(state.flag_counts) }
	if final and rawget(_G, "UIColony") and rawget(_G, "CurrentMap") then
		local ok = pcall(function()
			local c = collect()
			local p = depot_pair(c)
			emit_totals(state, c, p, "stop")
			emit_hubs_and_depot(c, dist_api(), p, "stop")
		end)
		summary.final_dump = tostring(ok)
	end
	local P = pack_api()
	if P then P.TrainTrace = state.prev_trace end
	summary.trace_restored = tostring(P and P.TrainTrace)
	log("SOAK_STOP", summary, true)
	local thread = state.thread
	state.thread = nil
	if thread and IsValidThread(thread) and thread ~= CurrentThread() then DeleteThread(thread) end
	relabel()
	return summary
end

local function poll(state)
	local t = GameTime()
	if t == state.last_time then return end
	state.last_time = t
	poll_events(state)
	run_pending(state)
	local h = t // hour_ms()
	if h ~= state.hour then
		state.hour = h
		hourly(state)
	end
	if state.run_until and t >= state.run_until then
		local hrs = state.run_hours
		state.run_until, state.run_hours = nil, nil
		T.Run("speed", 0)
		local c = collect()
		local p = depot_pair(c)
		emit_totals(state, c, p, "run_done")
		emit_hubs_and_depot(c, dist_api(), p, "run_done")
		log("SOAK_EVENT", { what = "run_done", hours = hrs, paused = tostring(GetGameSpeed and GetGameSpeed() == "pause") }, true)
		T.Run("flush")
		T.Mark("SOAK_RUN_DONE")
		if rawget(_G, "PlayFX") then PlayFX("UIMenuNotificationStoryBit", "start") end
		relabel()
	end
end

local function configuration()
	local P = pack_api()
	if not P then return false, "Opt-In registry missing (SMROptInPack)" end
	if not rawget(_G, "UIColony") or not rawget(_G, "CurrentMap") then return false, "load a colony first" end
	return P
end

local function start(ctx, why)
	local P, reason = configuration()
	if not P then return false, reason end
	if S.state then return false, "the soak is already on" end
	local state = { cancelled = false, tick = 0, active = {}, pending = {}, flag_counts = {}, suppressed = 0,
		flags_this_hour = 0, prev_stock = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }),
		prev_cargo = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }), train_state = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }),
		known = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }), spawn_flagged = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }),
		station_sig = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }), hub_working = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }),
		queue = {}, queue_front = {}, modules = {}, code_errors = {}, pairing = {},
		errors = T.error_count, errors0 = T.error_count, prev_trace = P.TrainTrace,
		last_time = false, cabin_since = GameTime() }
	state.flags_total_printed = function()
		local n = 0
		for _, v in pairs(state.flag_counts) do n = n + v end
		return n - state.suppressed
	end
	local mark = ctx.mark("SOAK_ON")
	P.TrainTrace = true
	-- baselines: what exists now is not an event
	local c = collect()
	for _, train in ipairs(c.trains) do state.known[train] = true end
	local B = rawget(_G, "SMROptInTrainBay")
	state.bay_refused = type(B) == "table" and type(B.stats) == "table" and B.stats.refused or 0
	state.code_errors = code_errors()
	for _, m in ipairs(MODULES) do state.modules[m] = P.IsActive(m) and true or false end
	local h = GameTime() // hour_ms()
	state.hour, state.start_hour = h, h
	state.last_summary, state.last_dump = h, h
	local fix = rawget(_G, "SMRFixPack")
	local modules = {}
	for _, m in ipairs(MODULES) do
		modules[#modules + 1] = m .. ":" .. (P.IsActive(m) and "on" or "off")
	end
	local p = depot_pair(c)
	local fields = { mark = mark, why = why, sol = UIColony.day, h = h, modules = table.concat(modules, ","),
		optin_version = type(P.PackVersion) == "function" and P.PackVersion() or "?",
		fixpack = fix and (type(fix.PackVersion) == "function" and fix.PackVersion() or "present") or "absent",
		trace_before = tostring(state.prev_trace), hubs = #c.hubs, stations = #c.stations, depots = #c.depots,
		trains = #c.trains, config = "poll_ms:" .. CFG.poll_ms .. ",summary_h:" .. CFG.summary_every_h
			.. ",dump_h:" .. CFG.dump_every_h .. ",lines_per_tick:" .. CFG.lines_per_tick
			.. ",flags_per_hour:" .. CFG.flags_per_hour .. ",stuck_h:" .. CFG.stuck_h }
	log("SOAK_START", fields, true)
	-- the full baseline: totals, every hub, the depot, every station and train
	emit_totals(state, c, p, "start")
	emit_hubs_and_depot(c, dist_api(), p, "start")
	local D = dist_api()
	for _, h in ipairs(c.hubs) do
		state.hub_working[h] = tostring(h.working) .. "/" .. tostring(h.ui_working) .. "/" .. tostring(h.destroyed or false)
	end
	for _, st in ipairs(c.stations) do
		state.station_sig[st] = station_signature(D, st)
		state.queue[#state.queue + 1] = { "station", st, "start" }
	end
	for _, train in ipairs(c.trains) do
		state.train_state[train] = { sig = train_sig(train), since = GameTime() }
		state.queue[#state.queue + 1] = { "train", train, "start" }
	end
	S.state = state
	state.thread = CreateRealTimeThread(function()
		while S.state == state and not state.cancelled do
			Sleep(CFG.poll_ms)
			if S.state ~= state or state.cancelled then break end
			if not rawget(_G, "SavingGame") and rawget(_G, "CurrentMap") and rawget(_G, "UIColony") then
				local ok, err = pcall(poll, state)
				if not ok then
					log("SOAK_FLAG", { kind = "soak_internal", message = tostring(err) }, true)
					stop("soak code error", false)
					break
				end
			end
		end
	end)
	relabel()
	fields.stream = "on"
	return fields
end

-- ---- saves, loads, maps: the soak survives a save and stops visibly on a load ---------------------
function OnMsg.SaveGameStart(params)
	if S.state then log("SOAK_EVENT", { what = "save_start", autosave = tostring(type(params) == "table" and params.autosave or false) }) end
end
function OnMsg.SaveGameDone(name, autosave, err)
	if S.state then log("SOAK_EVENT", { what = "save_done", name = tostring(name), autosave = tostring(autosave or false),
		err = tostring(err or "none"), continuing = "true" }) end
end
function OnMsg.CurrentMapChange()
	if S.state then log("SOAK_EVENT", { what = "view_map", map = tostring(rawget(_G, "CurrentMap")), continuing = "true" }) end
end
function OnMsg.PreLoadGame() if S.state then stop("PreLoadGame", false) end end
function OnMsg.LoadGame() if S.state then stop("LoadGame", false) end end
function OnMsg.DoneGame() if S.state then stop("DoneGame", false) end end

-- ---- slots -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
T.Bind(1, "SOAK OFF - press to start", function(ctx)
	if S.state then
		local mark = ctx.mark("SOAK_OFF")
		local summary = stop("manual", true)
		summary.mark, summary.stream = mark, "off"
		return summary
	end
	return start(ctx, "slot1")
end, { mode = "once" })

T.Bind(2, "Read now: one full snapshot - totals, every hub, the depot pair, every station and train (no pause needed)", function(ctx)
	local P, reason = configuration()
	if not P then return false, reason end
	local mark = ctx.mark("SOAK_READ")
	local c = collect()
	local D = dist_api()
	local p = depot_pair(c)
	local state = S.state
	local scratch = state or { pairing = {}, active = {}, suppressed = 0, errors0 = T.error_count,
		flags_total_printed = function() return 0 end }
	local modules = {}
	for _, m in ipairs(MODULES) do modules[#modules + 1] = m .. ":" .. (P.IsActive(m) and "on" or "off") end
	log("SOAK_READ", { soak = tostring(state and true or false), modules = table.concat(modules, ","),
		trace = tostring(P.TrainTrace), sol = UIColony.day, h = GameTime() // hour_ms() })
	emit_totals(scratch, c, p, "read", true)
	emit_hubs_and_depot(c, D, p, "read")
	for _, st in ipairs(c.stations) do log("SOAK_STATION", station_fields(D, st, "read")) end
	for _, train in ipairs(c.trains) do
		local r = state and state.train_state[train]
		log("SOAK_TRAIN", train_fields(train, "read", r and r.since))
	end
	local active = {}
	for _, a in pairs(state and state.active or empty_table) do active[a.kind] = (active[a.kind] or 0) + 1 end
	local done = ctx.mark("SOAK_READ_DONE")
	return { mark = mark, done = done, hubs = #c.hubs, stations = #c.stations, depots = #c.depots,
		trains = #c.trains, soak = tostring(state and true or false), active_flags = count_text(active),
		errors = T.error_count }
end, { mode = "once" })

local function hours_from_note()
	local note = T.agent_note
	local n = type(note) == "string" and tonumber(note:match("^%s*(%d+)%s*$")) or nil
	if n and math.type(n) == "integer" and n >= 1 and n <= CFG.run_max_h then return n, "note" end
	return CFG.run_default_h, "default"
end

T.Bind(3, "Run Ultra for N game hours, then pause + flush", function(ctx)
	if S.state and S.state.run_until then
		S.state.run_until, S.state.run_hours = nil, nil
		log("SOAK_EVENT", { what = "run_cancelled" }, true)
		relabel()
		return { run = "cancelled", soak = "on" }
	end
	local P, reason = configuration()
	if not P then return false, reason end
	local n, source = hours_from_note()
	local started
	if not S.state then
		local fields, why = start(ctx, "slot3")
		if not fields then return false, why end
		started = true
	end
	local sped, speed_fields = T.Run("speed_ultra")
	if not sped then return false, "speed refused: " .. tostring(speed_fields and speed_fields.reason) end
	S.state.run_until = GameTime() + n * hour_ms()
	S.state.run_hours = n
	local mark = ctx.mark("SOAK_RUN_" .. tostring(n) .. "H")
	relabel()
	return { mark = mark, hours = n, hours_source = source, until_h = S.state.run_until // hour_ms(),
		soak_started = tostring(started or false), factor = speed_fields and speed_fields.factor,
		clamped_by = speed_fields and speed_fields.clamped_by or "none" }
end, { mode = "once" })

relabel()
